create_llm_token_classifier: create an LLM instance for token classification using vLLM with pooling runner and NeuroBERT-NER model
run_ner_inference: run offline named entity recognition inference on sample prompts using token classification pooling task
parse_cli_args: parse command-line arguments with FlexibleArgumentParser and EngineArgs defaults for vLLM model configuration
tokenize_and_predict: tokenize input prompts and map model logits to named entity labels using id2label mapping
get_tokenizer_and_config: retrieve tokenizer and model configuration including id2label map from the vLLM LLM engine instance
